descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-15 Ask AI · S11 「Medication Tracker 是空的——用药快捷问题（养老院）」 Empty Medication Tracker — medications preset (Nursing Home)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U5 The current-medications answer reflects the Medication Tracker; held drugs show as held.（UAT TC-15；TFA-92593 AC 7）
  • U4 Answers are grounded only in that patient's data: no cross-patient bleed, no invented information, no outside data; per 3.4 no guessed units on ambiguous values and no narration of documentation stat …（UAT TC-15；TFA-92593 AC 3；UAT 3.4）

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given Resident with medications: []

When Ask "What medications is the patient on?"

Then Answer says no medications are recorded and names no drug

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：saysNone (SAYS_NONE accepts 'no medications recorded'; a miss on clearly-worded 'not on any medications' is checked against the quoted answer before it is called a Fail) and no drug name from any fixture in this matrix (U4)

在哪跑：dev 单元 U31；测试方法 AICHECK · AI 输出检查；矩阵里排的车道 AI 检查（automated）

S11 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-15.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AICHECK · AI 输出检查；辅助：AGENT · 浏览器 agent — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
